description: This file defines the Properties class responsible for reading and processing document properties (standard and custom) from XML data in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It interacts with the Spreadsheet and DocumentProperties classes to update metadata such as title, author, created date, etc.

classes.name: Properties
classes.description: A class responsible for reading document properties from an XML element and applying them to a Spreadsheet's document properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Properties class with a Spreadsheet object.

methods.name: readProperties
methods.description: Reads both standard and custom properties from an XML element and applies them to the spreadsheet.

methods.name: readStandardProperties
methods.description: Parses standard document properties from the XML and updates the spreadsheet's document properties accordingly.

methods.name: readCustomProperties
methods.description: Parses custom document properties from the XML and updates the spreadsheet's document properties accordingly.

methods.name: processStandardProperty
methods.description: Sets a standard property in the document properties based on the property name and value.

methods.name: processCustomProperty
methods.description: Sets a custom property in the document properties with appropriate type conversion.

methods.name: hex2str
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal value to a UTF-8 character.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves attributes of an XML element for a specified namespace.
